executiveSummary: Critical vCenter authentication bypass (CVE-2026-123890) is under active exploitation by a China-linked actor to gain admin access and abuse SAML/STS; patch immediately and restrict vCenter/ESXi management exposure. View Article Firewall management planes exposed to the Internet are being compromised via chained PHP zero-days, with kernel LPE to root on PAN-OS devices; remove public access and apply vendor updates/WAF mitigations now. View Article Siemens S7 PLCs: multi-agency alert warns of active targeting using S7comm and AI-assisted scripts; isolate controllers, block TCP/102, and harden engineering workstations. Security Advisory Nation-state operators are leveraging covert SOHO/IoT botnets and misconfigured routers to mask operations and pre-position in critical infrastructure networks; prioritize edge hardening and monitoring. Security Advisory Security Advisory Ransomware operators continue to weaponize virtualization layers using only native vCenter/ESXi features; treat vCenter as Tier-0, segregate identities, and ensure offline immutable backups. Supporting Report Multiple high-severity web-stack issues (PHP, NGINX, Brotli, Drupal) affect public-facing portals that can be bridges into OT-adjacent networks; update and apply virtual patching. Vendor Advisory View Article

relevance: Virtualization dependency: Many ICS servers (HMI, historians, eng. workstations) run on vSphere. vCenter compromise can cascade into OT if segmentation and identity separation are weak. Supporting Report Perimeter device exploitation (PAN-OS, routers) jeopardizes OT firewalls/DMZs and remote access pathways commonly used by integrators and vendors. descriptions: Initial Access: Exploit Public-Facing App (T1190), Valid Accounts (T1078), Supply Chain (T1195), External Remote Services (T1133)
Execution/Lateral Movement: PSExec/WinRM/WMI (T1570/T1021), Webshell (T1505), S7comm PUT/GET; vCenter/ESXi native operations
Defense Evasion: SAML/STS abuse (Golden SAML), AnyDesk/TeamViewer, covert SOHO/IoT proxies (T1090)
Credential Access: Mimikatz/LSASS (T1003), VPN/VDI auth manipulation
Exfiltration: Cloud storage (OneDrive, Mega) (T1567), DNS/HTTPS covert channels

outlook72h: Expect continued exploitation attempts against vCenter and PHP-exposed management planes; prioritize hotfix windows and isolation even if full upgrade is deferred. Increase telemetry on router/SOHO edges; block unsolicited SNMP/TFTP and alert on config copy OIDs and anomalous egress to residential networks. Conduct focused hunts for S7comm writes/unauthorized program downloads; validate PLC and engineering station access lists. Rehearse ransomware response for hypervisor-layer attacks; verify restore of ICS-supporting VMs from offline/immutable backups.
